 The upgraded statistics publisher freezes estimates/time, creates the R2 archive without overwriting a retained key, validates its acknowledgement, then awaits live KV publication. Same-millisecond/reset/restart collisions try at most eight positive safe-integer versions; only a definite collision advances, while missing, failed or malformed acknowledgements stop. Final serialized bytes remain within the snapshot budget. Publication failure schedules another attempt in30 seconds and still fails; scheduling failure also fails. State/prior/snapshot refusals retain their existing behavior. Operator publish/reset requires coherent downstream success; failures return503 and reset does not append a successful revision. KV or item-reset may already have committed, so failure is not rollback. Ambiguous archive writes may leave orphan versions. This does not establish globally chronological/idempotent version identity, retention/history repair or mixed-version rollout. Old unconditional publishers and externally removed/corrupt archives remain separate work; no extra decision hot-path read is added.
 
-New decision inputs include `replay: {version:1, learning, candidateLimit, slots:[{slot,lift,prior}]}`: the ordered full page's effective learning presence, candidate limit and snapshot identities. Pins/default-arm slots name zero dependencies. Replay validates this manifest and required archive owner/version/prior/consumed structure, then runs the ranked prefix through the target; a genuine catalog pin runs alone without unused archives. Gamma zero still requires any snapshots used for raw receipts or exploration. Returned records retain detached full-page inputs; `used.lift/prior` describes the consumed target snapshot, while the manifest can name later archives that were not read. Comparison includes authority and exploration metadata. Absent legacy personalized multi-slot manifests refuse; default/pin and qualified single-slot compatibility cannot recover arbitrary old pure-call candidate limits or ambiguous zero-lift exploration/controls. Present malformed manifests never become legacy fallback. Repeated page metadata counts toward existing full-record queue budgets. This is deterministic forward replay, not cryptographic receipt integrity, repaired archives, complete retention/rollout/resource assurance or statistical validation of Thompson exploration.

 Replay requires nonnegative safe-integer `catalog`, `slots`, `learn`, `lift` and `prior` identities before dependency reads; malformed tuples cannot silently select defaults. Missing pre-Phase3 document identities retain their explicit refusal. Integer zero remains the compiled/default or absent-dependency convention. A positive configuration dependency must return an envelope bearing exactly its requested revision before its value is used. These failures retain the authenticated route's `ok:false` result, no-store and audited-read behavior, without implying a scoring mismatch. This cannot detect a different valid body overwritten under the same revision or pin the historical compiled defaults/reader code; immutable slots/learn publication, old data repair, retention and rollout remain separate work.
 
 Snapshots contain only their named identity fields and estimates, not raw statistics/configuration. Prior documents are gated at4096 rows/256KiB before indexing/building; selected keys allow at most six components/2048 bytes, and actual item/key/ancestor expansion shares the256-item/4096-counter limits. Output is capped at2MiB before response/publication. This gate follows the existing configuration read/validation, so it is not a bound on raw KV parsing/import allocation. L3 — Outcome learning: what works

The engine accumulates per-item, context-conditioned outcome statistics over the open catalog: for each content item and context cell (channel × visit bucket × region, as agreed), a smoothed conversion lift versus that context's baseline — empirical-Bayes smoothing toward 1.0 with a configurable prior strength, so small samples don't produce wild swings. Ranking scores are multiplied by lift, so assets that demonstrably work for a context rise for that context.

-

New or under-observed content receives a configurable exploration share per slot (default 10%): a deterministic rotation guarantees fresh assets accumulate evidence instead of starving. Note what this is not: it is not variation buckets, and it is not bandit-dependent — it is item-level statistics over the whole catalog, the same way product recommendations learn. A contextual bandit (CMAB) remains available as an optional per-slot instrument if your team wants controlled variation testing on a specific placement; it is never required for the system to learn. The learned lift reaches a decision through one dial per slot, from 0 (computed and shown on every receipt, ignored in ranking) to 1 (applied in full), so learning launches in shadow and is turned up where a person decides it has earned it. A holdout is part of the design rather than a later study: a stable share of visitors is assigned before the first decision is recorded, sees your defaults, and the daily report compares the arms with the interval around the difference and the number of decisions it would take to call it.

+

Exploration is off in the shipped default. An operator can explicitly configure a per-slot rotation or epsilon share; the UI initializes 10% and a floor of 50 when enabling it. Rotation considers eligible under-observed content but does not guarantee that fresh assets accumulate evidence or reach a minimum impression count. It is not variation buckets or a requirement for ordinary item-level learning. Thompson is withdrawn; an evaluated contextual-bandit instrument remains separate work, not a delivered option. Offline analysis over the accumulated decision-and-outcome corpus — cohort contrasts, predictive-attribute analysis per channel — surfaces proposals: "this behavior predicts conversion for paid-social visitors; want it as a dimension weight? as an audience?" Proposals are human-approved, never self-activating, and they arrive with the evidence that produced them. This is also where the registry grows over time, governed.
